sections.title: Heat and Mass Transport
sections.description: Steady-state heat conduction. The energy equation. Fourier's law. Unsteady-state conduction. Convective heat transfer. Radiation. Design of heat transfer equipment. Diffusion, fluxes, and component conservation equations. Convective mass transfer. Interphase mass transport coefficients. Prerequisite required: CBE 3500 Fluid Mechanics.
